title: Decapitated man buried near fort in Roman-era Scotland gets a new virtual face
caption:
A 2,000-year-old skeleton found near a Roman fort in Scotland has been given a new facial reconstruction. Despite his dignified burial, the man was decapitated after death—a bizarre ritual that still puzzles researchers today.

Source: Livescience - Decapitated man buried near fort in Roman-era Scotland gets a new virtual face
